name: Automation and AI agents
line: The work happens without anyone doing it.
what: We take the work your team does by hand every week and rebuild it so it runs on its own.
examples: Forms that write the job and the invoice
Systems that update each other overnight

name: Reporting and dashboards
line: See how the business is doing in time to act.
what: We connect your systems so your reports build themselves and arrive while you can still act on them.
examples: Job costing while the job is running
Dashboards the whole team can read

name: Websites and software
line: A site or a tool built for how you actually work.
what: We build websites you can edit yourself and software shaped to the way your business runs.

name: Branding and graphic design
line: Look like the business you have become.
what: We design the brand, the documents and the print your business sends out.
